data.schedule_hide_cancelled_no_highlight: Hide cancellations when highlighting is off

data_description.enable_letters: Number and titles of unread parent letters. Letters are not opened, so they stay unread in the app.
data_description.enable_messages: Number of unread messages and affected conversations. Message texts are not loaded, so no read receipts are sent.

school_login_rejected.title: Schulmanager rejected the password for some schools
school_login_rejected.description:
Schulmanager rejected the configured password for: {schools}. Students of these schools are missing.

In Schulmanager, every school has its own account, even when they share the same e-mail address, and each account has its own password. Log in at https://login.schulmanager-online.de and select the school: if the password is refused there as well, set the same password for all your school accounts and reload the integration.

school_two_factor_required.title: Two-factor code needed
school_two_factor_required.description:
Schulmanager asks for a new two-factor code for: {schools}. Students of these schools are missing until it is entered.

This happens when the device that Schulmanager remembered for Home Assistant has expired or was removed, or when two-factor authentication was switched on.

code.title: Enter two-factor code
code.description: Enter the current code for the Schulmanager account of {school}, from your authenticator app or from the Schulmanager e-mail. Schulmanager then remembers Home Assistant as a device again.

error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. Enter the current code and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Schulmanager. Try again later.

abort.password_rejected: Schulmanager rejected the stored password. Re-authenticate the integration under Settings → Devices & services.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Schulmanager. Try again later.
